study: D10: stationary compressible and constant-density Euler vortex balance

air.locator: Equation (11) and Table 3, printed p. 35 / PDF p. 5
air.notes: Dry-air reference. Mean free path uses the NIST paper's convention. Density and sound speed are ideal-gas estimates using rounded R and gamma assumptions, not additional measured NIST values. Properties are frozen for screening, not evolved along collapse.

radius_interpretation: fixed radius of peak speed, independent of the D1 collapse anchor
mach_definition: peak swirl speed divided by EXTERIOR sound speed; local Mach is separately evaluated
thermodynamics: calorically perfect ideal gas; spatially uniform entropy; exact steady Euler equilibrium
physical_limits: no viscosity, heat conduction, time evolution, phase change, or calibrated OpenAI flow; local mean-free-path variation is an approximation using NIST Eq.11
